landing.heroTitle: From a department's problem to a paid, proven pilot.
landing.heroSubtitle: A legally structured pathway to write outcome-based challenges, discover startups, run controlled pilots, pay on milestones, and scale only what independent evidence supports.

tour.label: Guided Tour
tour.step1Body: Pilot Bridge is the full lifecycle platform for government-startup innovation. Pick a role persona to begin — start with Officer (Meera Kulkarni) to follow the hero flow.
tour.step2Body: Ten stages from Challenge through Scale-up. Each column is a lifecycle stage. Drag a ticket between stages — the gate checklist will stop you if exit conditions are not met.
tour.step3Body: Write a problem statement, watch the AI drafting assistant stream a draft, check the quality score, and send for sign-off. The statement quality analyser flags vague baselines.
tour.step4Body: The TF-IDF matching engine ranks 32 seeded startups by fit score and explains why each was ranked. Invite up to three to apply, then advance the demo clock past the deadline.
tour.step5Body: Run eligibility rules against each application. Use the what-if slider to see how relaxing the turnover threshold changes the shortlist. Shortlist three to advance.
tour.step6Body: Switch to Evaluator (Dr Arvind Rao). Declare no conflict of interest, then score the startup in blind mode using the weighted rubric. Lock your scores when done.
tour.step7Body: Back as Officer, review the score matrix across all evaluators. Flag spread scores that need discussion. Approve the final ranking to advance to Pilot Design.
tour.step8Body: Switch to Finance (Rakesh Menon) on CH-014. The SLA ring counts down days. Verify evidence, approve as a second user, and release the milestone payment. Watch the Stone change.
